player: Shiki remains at participant stands, upper tier; no voluntarily declared action or response to genjutsu yet. Do not declare his personal thoughts or that he has automatically broken the illusion.

played.match_final: Gaara beat Neji 12:01; shortly after final, 12:12–12:16 invasion begins.

sequence.what: Subtle bell, guards and audience begin going to sleep across stands.

White feathers appear in implausible directions, mass sleep genjutsu suspected. Genma warns, Leaf shinobi attempt kai. Assailant disguised as worker stabs Leaf guard. Three fake staff reveal Sound insignia, order to close north gate and take medical corridor.

Explosion on Kage box roof; Four Violet Flames barrier erected, enclosing Hokage Hiruzen and person posing as Kazekage. Hokage audibly names 'Орочимару' as he sees long-haired pale man. Another jonin contacts hot barrier and is burned.

Northern exit closed, explosion destroys some stairs, trapped and injured people. Kabuto in familiar medic clothes appears in western access, notices Shiki and touches his glasses, then withdraws behind column; his motives and exact next actions unknown. Temari and Kankuro urge Gaara to leave, he begins moving, not attacking Shiki.

Two Sound shinobi at door of medical wing, about 10m away one tier below Shiki. Stocky one with metal plates on wrist spots Kusa headband and briefly makes two-finger sign vaguely reminiscent of Forest of Death signals, meaning not known. Slender one prepares paper sealing tag on doorway, not yet active; door contains patients including Aki and Ren. Mednurse within bangs door, calls to let them through. Player has immediate actionable window before seal completed.
